items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: the only income was an occasional weekend, which Wil- lard was forcing us to do

ctx.x: I believe so, but let's talk about it a little more. We kind of said it in passing.

Ever since the first time out, we began losing money and it was suggested from the agency, Willard Alexander agency, that we cut down the size of the band and stop playing what we're doing and play dance music. I'm sure that Miller's getting that too, that's the only thing he knows when it comes down to that. But we wouldn't do that, there would be no purpose. I wouldn't do it today; there is no purpose at all in doing it that way. So we said (inaudible) so that we can at least break even, so it doesn't
keep on adding up that way, and that was the end of the band.
